fire: A firewall is a system that filters network traffic.

Simply put, phishing is a scam that tricks users into giving passwords.
A mortgage is a loan used to buy a house.
Technically, a worm is a program that copies itself across networks.
An aneurysm is a bulge in the wall of a blood vessel.
A patent is a legal right granted to an inventor.
Ransomware is a type of malware that locks your files.

The movie is a lot of fun for kids.
Tom is a big fan of jazz and blues.
